verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵ֗נִי אֶל־ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ הַחִ֣יצוֹנָ֔ה הַדֶּ֖רֶךְ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֑וֹן וַיְבִאֵ֣נִי אֶל־ הַלִּשְׁכָּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נֶ֧גֶד הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וַאֲשֶֽׁר־ נֶ֥גֶד הַבִּנְיָ֖ן אֶל־ הַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi·’ê·nî ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh had·de·reḵ de·reḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn way·ḇi·’ê·nî ’el- hal·liš·kāh ’ă·šer ne·ḡeḏ hag·giz·rāh wa·’ă·šer- ne·ḡeḏ hab·bin·yān ’el- haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: Then the man led me out northward into the outer court and he brought me to the group of chambers opposite the temple courtyard and the outer wall on the north side
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS disto fez-me sair para fora, ao átrio exterior, para o lado do caminho do norte; e me levou às câmaras que estavam defronte do lugar separado, e que estavam defronte do edifício, do lado norte.

verses.original: אֶל־ פְּנֵי־ אֹ֙רֶךְ֙ אַמּ֣וֹת הַמֵּאָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח הַצָּפ֑וֹן וְהָרֹ֖חַב חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’el- pə·nê- ’ō·reḵ ’am·mō·wṯ ham·mê·’āh pe·ṯaḥ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn wə·hā·rō·ḥaḇ ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: The building with the door facing north was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide
verses.literalPt: Do comprimento de cem côvados, era a entrada do norte; e a largura era de cinqüenta côvados.

verses.original: נֶ֣גֶד הָֽעֶשְׂרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֙ לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְנֶ֣גֶד רִֽצְפָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִֽיצוֹנָ֑ה אַתִּ֥יק אֶל־ פְּנֵֽי־ אַתִּ֖יק בַּשְּׁלִשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ne·ḡeḏ hā·‘eś·rîm ’ă·šer le·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mî wə·ne·ḡeḏ riṣ·p̄āh ’ă·šer le·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh ’at·tîq ’el- pə·nê- ’at·tîq baš·šə·li·šîm
verses.literal: Gallery faced gallery in three levels opposite the twenty cubits that belonged to the inner court and opposite the pavement that belonged to the outer court
verses.literalPt: Em frente dos vinte côvados, que tinha o átrio interior, e em frente do pavimento que tinha o átrio exterior, havia galeria contra galeria em três andares.

verses.original: וְלִפְנֵ֨י הַלְּשָׁכ֜וֹת מַהֲלַךְ֩ עֶ֨שֶׂר אַמּ֥וֹת רֹ֙חַב֙ אֶל־ הַפְּנִימִ֔ית דֶּ֖רֶךְ אַמָּ֣ה אֶחָ֑ת וּפִתְחֵיהֶ֖ם לַצָּפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lip̄·nê hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ma·hă·laḵ ‘e·śer ’am·mō·wṯ rō·ḥaḇ ’el- hap·pə·nî·mîṯ de·reḵ ’am·māh ’e·ḥāṯ ū·p̄iṯ·ḥê·hem laṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: In front of the chambers was an inner walkway . . . . . . ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long Their doors were on the north
verses.literalPt: E diante das câmaras havia um passeio de dez côvados de largo, do lado de dentro, e um caminho de um côvado, e as suas entradas eram para o lado do norte.

verses.original: וְהַלְּשָׁכ֥וֹת הָעֶלְיוֹנֹ֖ת קְצֻר֑וֹת כִּֽי־ יוֹכְל֨וּ אַתִּיקִ֜ים מֵהֵ֗נָה מֵֽהַתַּחְתֹּנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽכֹנ֖וֹת בִּנְיָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ hā·‘el·yō·w·nōṯ qə·ṣu·rō·wṯ kî- yō·wḵ·lū ’at·tî·qîm mê·hê·nāh mê·hat·taḥ·tō·nō·wṯ ū·mê·hat·ti·ḵō·nō·wṯ bin·yān
verses.literal: Now the upper chambers were smaller because the galleries took more space from the chambers on the lower and middle floors of the building
verses.literalPt: E as câmaras superiores eram mais estreitas; porque as galerias tomavam aqui mais espaço do que as de baixo e as do meio do edifício.

verses.original: כִּ֤י מְשֻׁלָּשׁוֹת֙ הֵ֔נָּה וְאֵ֤ין לָהֶן֙ עַמּוּדִ֔ים כְּעַמּוּדֵ֖י הַחֲצֵר֑וֹת עַל־ כֵּ֣ן נֶאֱצַ֗ל מֵהַתַּחְתּוֹנ֛וֹת וּמֵהַתִּֽיכֹנ֖וֹת מֵהָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: kî mə·šul·lā·šō·wṯ hên·nāh wə·’ên lā·hen ‘am·mū·ḏîm kə·‘am·mū·ḏê ha·ḥă·ṣê·rō·wṯ ‘al- kên ne·’ĕ·ṣal mê·hat·taḥ·tō·w·nō·wṯ ū·mê·hat·tî·ḵō·nō·wṯ mê·hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: For they were arranged in three stories and unlike the courts they had no pillars So . . . the upper chambers were set back further than the lower and middle floors
verses.literalPt: Porque elas eram de três andares, e não tinham colunas como as colunas dos átrios; por isso desde o chão se iam estreitando, mais do que as de baixo e as do meio.

verses.original: וְגָדֵ֤ר אֲשֶׁר־ לַחוּץ֙ לְעֻמַּ֣ת הַלְּשָׁכ֔וֹת דֶּ֛רֶךְ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת אָרְכּ֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡā·ḏêr ’ă·šer- la·ḥūṣ lə·‘um·maṯ hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ de·reḵ he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥi·ṣō·w·nāh ’el- pə·nê hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ’ā·rə·kōw ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh
verses.literal: An outer wall in front of the chambers was fifty cubits long and ran parallel to the chambers and the outer court
verses.literalPt: E o muro que estava de fora, defronte das câmaras, no caminho do átrio exterior, diante das câmaras, tinha cinqüenta côvados de comprimento.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ אֹ֣רֶךְ הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֶחָצֵ֥ר הַחִֽצוֹנָ֖ה חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֑ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַהֵיכָ֖ל מֵאָ֥ה אַמָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ’ō·reḵ hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ’ă·šer le·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥi·ṣō·w·nāh ḥă·miš·šîm ’am·māh wə·hin·nêh ‘al- pə·nê ha·hê·ḵāl mê·’āh ’am·māh
verses.literal: For the chambers on the outer court were fifty cubits . . . long while those facing . . . the temple were a hundred cubits long
verses.literalPt: Pois o comprimento das câmaras, que estavam no átrio exterior, era de cinqüenta côvados; e eis que defronte do templo havia cem côvados.

verses.original: וּמִתַּחֲתָה לְּשָׁכוֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הַמָּבוֹא מֵֽהַקָּדִ֔ים בְּבֹא֣וֹ לָהֵ֔נָּה מֵֽהֶחָצֵ֖ר הַחִצֹנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mit·ta·ḥă·ṯå̄h lə·šå̄·ḵōṯ hā·’êl·leh ham·må̄·ḇō mê·haq·qā·ḏîm bə·ḇō·’ōw lā·hên·nāh mê·he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥi·ṣō·nāh
verses.literal: And below these chambers was the entrance on the east side as one enters them from the outer court
verses.literalPt: Por baixo destas câmaras estava a entrada do lado do oriente, quando se entra nelas pelo átrio exterior.

verses.original: בְּרֹ֣חַב׀ גֶּ֣דֶר הֶחָצֵ֗ר דֶּ֧רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֛ים אֶל־ פְּנֵ֧י הַגִּזְרָ֛ה וְאֶל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַבִּנְיָ֖ן לְשָׁכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rō·ḥaḇ ge·ḏer he·ḥā·ṣêr de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm ’el- pə·nê hag·giz·rāh wə·’el- pə·nê hab·bin·yān lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: On the south side along the length of the wall of the outer court were chambers adjoining the courtyard and opposite the building
verses.literalPt: Na largura do muro do átrio para o lado do oriente, diante do lugar separado, e diante do edifício, havia também câmaras.

verses.original: וְדֶ֙רֶךְ֙ לִפְנֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמַרְאֵ֣ה הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַצָּפ֔וֹן כְּאָרְכָּ֖ן כֵּ֣ן רָחְבָּ֑ן וְכֹל֙ מוֹצָ֣אֵיהֶ֔ן וּכְמִשְׁפְּטֵיהֶ֖ן וּכְפִתְחֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏe·reḵ lip̄·nê·hem kə·mar·’êh hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ’ă·šer de·reḵ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn kə·’ā·rə·kān kên rā·ḥə·bān wə·ḵōl mō·w·ṣā·’ê·hen ū·ḵə·miš·pə·ṭê·hen ū·ḵə·p̄iṯ·ḥê·hen
verses.literal: with a passageway in front of them . . . just like the chambers that were on the north They had the same length . . . and width with similar exits and dimensions . . .
verses.literalPt: E o caminho que havia diante delas era da aparência das câmaras, que davam para o norte; conforme o seu comprimento, assim era a sua largura; e todas as suas saídas eram também conforme os seus padrões, e conforme as suas entradas.

verses.original: וּכְפִתְחֵ֣י הַלְּשָׁכ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁר֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַדָּר֔וֹם פֶּ֖תַח בְּרֹ֣אשׁ דָּ֑רֶךְ דֶּ֗רֶךְ בִּפְנֵי֙ הַגְּדֶ֣רֶת הֲגִינָ֔ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֖ים בְּבוֹאָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·p̄iṯ·ḥê hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ ’ă·šer de·reḵ had·dā·rō·wm pe·ṯaḥ bə·rōš dā·reḵ de·reḵ bip̄·nê hag·gə·ḏe·reṯ hă·ḡî·nāh de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm bə·ḇō·w·’ān
verses.literal: And corresponding to the doors of the chambers that were facing south there was a door in front of the walkway . . . that was parallel to the wall extending . . . eastward
verses.literalPt: E conforme as portas das câmaras, que olhavam para o caminho do sul, havia também uma entrada no topo do caminho, isto é, do caminho em frente do muro direito, para o caminho do oriente, quando se entra por elas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י לִֽשְׁכ֨וֹת הַצָּפ֜וֹן לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַדָּרוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַגִּזְרָה֒ הֵ֣נָּה׀ לִֽשְׁכ֣וֹת הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יֹאכְלוּ־ שָׁ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר־ קְרוֹבִ֥ים לַֽיהוָ֖ה קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים שָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֣יחוּ׀ קָדְשֵׁ֣י הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים וְהַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם כִּ֥י הַמָּק֖וֹם קָדֹֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay liš·ḵō·wṯ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn liš·ḵō·wṯ had·dā·rō·wm ’ă·šer ’el- pə·nê hag·giz·rāh hên·nāh liš·ḵō·wṯ haq·qō·ḏeš ’ă·šer yō·ḵə·lū- šām hak·kō·hă·nîm ’ă·šer- qə·rō·w·ḇîm Yah·weh qā·ḏə·šê haq·qo·ḏā·šîm šām yan·nî·ḥū qā·ḏə·šê haq·qo·ḏā·šîm wə·ham·min·ḥāh wə·ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’ā·šām kî ham·mā·qō·wm qā·ḏōš
verses.literal: Then the man said to me The north and south chambers facing . . . the temple courtyard . . . are the holy chambers where the priests who approach the LORD will eat the most holy offerings . . . There they will place the most holy offerings . . . the grain offerings the sin offerings and the guilt offerings for the place is holy
verses.literalPt: Então me disse: As câmaras do norte, e as câmaras do sul, que estão diante do lugar separado, elas são câmaras santas, em que os sacerdotes, que se chegam ao SENHOR, comerão as coisas mais santas; ali porão as coisas mais santas, e a oferta de manjar, a oferta pelo pecado, e a oferta pela culpa; porque o lugar é santo.

verses.original: בְּבֹאָ֣ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֗ים וְלֹֽא־ יֵצְא֤וּ מֵהַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֔ה וְשָׁ֞ם יַנִּ֧יחוּ בִגְדֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ יְשָׁרְת֥וּ בָהֶ֖ן כִּֽי־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֑נָּה יִלְבְּשׁוּ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְקָרְב֖וּ אֶל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇō·’ām hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lō- yê·ṣə·’ū mê·haq·qō·ḏeš ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh wə·šām yan·nî·ḥū ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem ’ă·šer- yə·šā·rə·ṯū ḇā·hen kî- qō·ḏeš hên·nāh yil·bə·šū bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·qā·rə·ḇū ’el- ’ă·šer lā·‘ām
verses.literal: Once the priests have entered the holy area they must not go out into the outer . . . court until they have left behind the garments in which they minister for these are holy They are to put on other clothes before they approach . . . the places that are for the people
verses.literalPt: Quando os sacerdotes entrarem, não sairão do santuário para o átrio exterior, mas porão ali as suas vestiduras com que ministraram, porque elas são santas; e vestir-se-ão de outras vestiduras, e assim se aproximarão do lugar pertencente ao povo.

verses.original: וְכִלָּ֗ה אֶת־ מִדּוֹת֙ הַבַּ֣יִת הַפְּנִימִ֔י וְהוֹצִיאַ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַשַּׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וּמְדָד֖וֹ סָבִ֥יב׀ סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵil·lāh ’eṯ- mid·dō·wṯ hab·ba·yiṯ hap·pə·nî·mî wə·hō·w·ṣî·’a·nî de·reḵ haš·ša·‘ar ’ă·šer pā·nāw de·reḵ haq·qā·ḏîm ū·mə·ḏā·ḏōw sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: Now when the man had finished measuring the interior of the temple area he led me out by the gate that faced . . . east and he measured the area all around
verses.literalPt: E, acabando ele de medir a casa interior, ele me fez sair pelo caminho da porta, cuja face olha para o caminho do oriente; e a mediu em redor.

verses.original: מָדַ֛ד ר֥וּחַ הַקָּדִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֣ה הַמִּדָּ֑ה חֲמֵשׁ־ אֵמוֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḏaḏ rū·aḥ haq·qā·ḏîm biq·nêh ham·mid·dāh ḥă·mêš- ʾē·mōṯ qā·nîm biq·nêh ham·mid·dāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: With a measuring rod he measured the east side to be five hundred cubits long
verses.literalPt: Mediu o lado oriental com a cana de medir, quinhentas canas, com a cana de medir, ao redor.

verses.original: מָדַ֖ד ר֣וּחַ הַצָּפ֑וֹן חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֛ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃
verses.transliteration: mā·ḏaḏ rū·aḥ haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ḥă·mêš- mê·’ō·wṯ qā·nîm biq·nêh ham·mid·dāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: He measured the north side to be five hundred cubits long . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Mediu o lado do norte, com a cana de medir, quinhentas canas ao redor.

verses.original: אֵ֛ת ר֥וּחַ הַדָּר֖וֹם מָדָ֑ד חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ rū·aḥ had·dā·rō·wm mā·ḏāḏ ḥă·mêš- mê·’ō·wṯ qā·nîm biq·nêh ham·mid·dāh
verses.literal: He measured the south side to be five hundred cubits long
verses.literalPt: Mediu também o lado do sul, com a cana de medir, quinhentas canas.

verses.original: סָבַ֖ב אֶל־ ר֣וּחַ הַיָּ֑ם מָדַ֛ד חֲמֵשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת קָנִ֖ים בִּקְנֵ֥ה הַמִּדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: sā·ḇaḇ ’el- rū·aḥ hay·yām mā·ḏaḏ ḥă·mêš- mê·’ō·wṯ qā·nîm biq·nêh ham·mid·dāh
verses.literal: And he came around and measured the west side to be five hundred cubits long
verses.literalPt: Deu uma volta para o lado do ocidente, e mediu, com a cana de medir, quinhentas canas.

verses.original: לְאַרְבַּ֨ע רוּח֜וֹת מְדָד֗וֹ ח֤וֹמָה לוֹ֙ סָבִ֣יב׀ סָבִ֔יב אֹ֚רֶךְ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְרֹ֖חַב חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·’ar·ba‘ rū·ḥō·wṯ mə·ḏā·ḏōw ḥō·w·māh lōw sā·ḇîḇ sā·ḇîḇ ’ō·reḵ ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·rō·ḥaḇ ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ lə·haḇ·dîl bên haq·qō·ḏeš lə·ḥōl
verses.literal: So he measured the area on all four sides It had a wall all around five hundred cubits long and five hundred cubits wide to separate . . . the holy from the common
verses.literalPt: Mediu pelos quatro lados; e havia um muro em redor, de quinhentas canas de comprimento, e quinhentas de largura, para fazer separação entre o santo e o profano.
